title: erophila verna var. lepida
intro: Erophila verna var. lepida, commonly known as Spring Whitlow-grass, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spring Whitlow-grass include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
